methodology.objective: Contrast specific notated academic examples against semantic assumptions in Cinemático, not classify composer identity.

evidenceGrades.A: Visible published score/transcription example personally inspected
evidenceGrades.B: Academic prose and named figure; visual figure not independently inspected in this step
evidenceGrades.X: Original hypothetical exercise used to test the engine

limitations: Only the cited fragment, not complete original studio scores
Chord symbols lack melody, tempo, meter and orchestration
Visual examples and academic transcriptions are not always the composer's autograph score
methodology.originality: Transcriptions and score pages stay at their originating URLs. Stored test fixtures are small analytical pitch-class abstractions, not copied passage notation.

observed.interpretation: E natural to F above B-flat: raised fourth moves up semitone to fifth. This is a melodic gesture; it cannot be inferred from Bbmaj7#11 alone.

observed.intervalChange: Melodic raised fourth lowered a semitone in the varied theme
observed.interpretation: Compare pitch alteration with maintained motivic identity, not an automatic mood label.
Bb-major and E-major triads are six semitone roots apart; simultaneous triadic layering is distinct from successive harmonies.
The union of the two major triads fits a six-note subset of one octatonic collection; this alone does not prove an octatonic passage, and meter cannot be inferred from chord labels.
Changes of meter make ostinato accents slide relative to bars. The web chord engine has no event timing.

cannotAssert: A #11 chord by itself constitutes a Lydian theme
Two consecutive tritone-related triads were simultanously layered
Octatonic provenance or instrumentation from six pitch classes alone
The precise emotional character of the theme without a listening task

observed.interpretation: A minor to A-flat major conserves C and moves two other notes a semitone.
Lehman labels a later five-class simultaneous combination SLIDEJOIN; unlike sequential S, it contains simultaneous notes from both triads.
The paper treats the sequence of L/R/S and other operators as a larger organized network. Single S operations cannot identify the film or composer.

cannotAssert: SLIDEJOIN is another spelling for a single S transition
The app's original P-L-R exercises reconstruct the published L/R/S route
One triad-to-triad move proves a specific film style
A transformation automatically creates the narrative meaning inferred by the analyst
